# Gate 2 package - BI-PF-1531
**EDP: make PostgreSQL backlog authority the default for PF-SB and PF-GP scopes**

## Plain language
**What/why:** Docs say PF_BACKLOG_DB defaults on but code/config default off. -> DB-default authority with parity, fail-closed, rollback, and CI evidence.

## Gate 0 reconciliation + impact
RECONCILIATION - BI-PF-1531
  prior_decisions : ['EDP-18 migration/import tooling exists.', 'EDP-22 provides SLO/observability.', 'PF_BACKLOG_DB is the intended backlog authority switch.']
  existing_path   : ['core/backlog.py', 'core/id_allocator.py', 'go/edpdata/backlog.go', 'scripts/dev/backlog_db_parity.py', 'scripts/dev/backlog_db_backfill.py']
  assumptions     : ['PostgreSQL is the shared SoR.', 'Legacy cross-scope IDs exist and must be preserved.', 'New IDs remain globally unique.']
  divergences     : ['Docs claimed default on while code defaulted off.', 'Legacy dashboard/product IDs collide with PF-SB IDs.']
  open_questions  : ['When to renumber vs permanently grandfather legacy scoped duplicates.']
IMPACT REVIEW
  claim | verdict | evidence | recommendation
  API CHECK: existing edpsvc backlog API; no new public route. | aligned | go/edpsvc/main.go::backlogHandle | keep admin auth
  AC CHECK: default, parity, fail-closed, rollback, and DB-mode CI are covered. | aligned | test_backlog_db_cutover.py + backlog_db_parity.py | verify at Gate 2
  LANGUAGE CHECK: Python thin client; DB writer remains Go edpsvc. | aligned | core/backlog.py -> edpsvc -> edpdata | no shipped Python DB writer
  DB CHECK: migration 0021 scopes legacy uniqueness while new IDs stay global. | aligned | migrations/0021_backlog_scoped_uniqueness.up.sql | backup before apply
  DR CHECK: DB backup/PITR/restore exists from EDP-23; cross-region DR remains T4. | aligned | BI-PF-1315 | keep T4 gated

## Gate 2.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 2.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=deepseek-v4.1-flash sha=c3dd2db7046b)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 14 (BLOCKER 2 / MAJOR 4 / MINOR 5 / NIT 3); dispositions: actioned 14; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | BLOCKER | Authoritative tenant is derived two different ways: `_db_for`/`db_authority_enabled` resolve the allowlist via `_scope_key` (aliases `portfolio`/`factory` → `product_forge`), but `_load_all`/`_load_all_from_db`/`_save_item`/`delete`/`_reserve_db` pass the raw `project\|scope` as the DB tenant — a legacy alias item is DB-enabled yet read/written under a tenant nobody lists, i.e. silent item loss with a green read path. | ACTIONED | Fixed in merged clean branch PR #346; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1531/current-sha-control.txt. |
| 2 | BLOCKER | Parity hides the same defect: `backlog_db_parity.file_items` filters by the raw `project or scope` tenant, so alias/misattributed rows are excluded from both sides and the "OK -> safe to set on" gate passes while those items are absent from the authoritative tenant. | ACTIONED | Fixed in merged clean branch PR #346; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1531/current-sha-control.txt. |
| 3 | MAJOR | `0022_traceability_tenant_index.up.sql` runs `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS` under `statement_timeout='60s'`; an aborted build leaves an INVALID index and `IF NOT EXISTS` never rebuilds it — no `indisvalid` post-check anywhere. | ACTIONED | Fixed in merged clean branch PR #346; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1531/current-sha-control.txt. |
| 4 | MAJOR | `go/edpdata.Authority()` now hard-requires migration 23 (`IN (16,18,19,20,21,23) HAVING count(*)=6`) while `functional_spec.assumptions` ("Migrations through 0022") and `prerequisites` ("0021 applied by rollout") omit 0023 — an operator following the declared prerequisites gets a service that refuses to start. | ACTIONED | Fixed in merged clean branch PR #346; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1531/current-sha-control.txt. |
| 5 | MAJOR | Disposition `sig:28c6b28f66eb4c0b` is marked ACTIONED citing `test-framework/tests/conftest.py`, which does not exist in this tree; the real `product-forge/conftest.py` is import-time, not autouse, and silently overrides an explicit `on`, so AC-2 file-mode isolation is neither implemented nor evidenced as claimed. | ACTIONED | Fixed in merged clean branch PR #346; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1531/current-sha-control.txt. |
| 6 | MAJOR | On-mode `delete()` removes the DB row first and then best-effort deletes the projection (`contextlib.suppress`); a suppressed failure leaves an orphan `items/<id>.json` that makes the documented export→parity rollback report drift and block the flip to `off`. | ACTIONED | Fixed in merged clean branch PR #346; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1531/current-sha-control.txt. |
| 7 | MINOR | `0023_backlog_global_id_guard.up.sql` runs `UPDATE` + non-concurrent `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX` on the shared table with only the single pre-0021 preflight; the workflow applies it with no 0023-specific backup/lock gate despite the `sig:f2bf86709c6d63ee` ACTIONED disposition. | ACTIONED | Fixed in merged clean branch PR #346; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1531/current-sha-control.txt. |
| 8 | MINOR | `data/backlog/items/BI-PF-1531.json` still carries `evidence: ["pending", ...]` and `status: "new"` while `control_evidence` reports `PASS` and `functional_spec.status` is `APPROVED`; likewise `deps: []` contradicts `dependencies: ["BI-PF-1315"]`. | ACTIONED | Fixed in merged clean branch PR #346; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1531/current-sha-control.txt. |
| 9 | MINOR | `_load_all_from_db` raises `BACKLOG_DB_TRUNCATED` when `len(items) >= 100000`, so a tenant with exactly the limit fails every read rather than paginating or reporting truncation. | ACTIONED | Fixed in merged clean branch PR #346; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1531/current-sha-control.txt. |
| 10 | MINOR | `config/store-registry.json` registers `config/functional-spec.json` / `config/spec-pack.json` alongside `residency_*_scratch` ignore entries, treating governance config as ephemeral and masking future drift in the enforced contracts. | ACTIONED | Fixed in merged clean branch PR #346; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1531/current-sha-control.txt. |
| 11 | MINOR | `scripts/dev/precheck.py` forces `PF_BACKLOG_DB=off` for the whole gate run, so `functional-spec`/`spec-pack`/`conformance` evaluate file projections only and can never reflect the DB-authoritative state they are meant to gate. | ACTIONED | Fixed in merged clean branch PR #346; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1531/current-sha-control.txt. |
| 12 | NIT | `functional_spec.open_questions` and `docs/PF-DESIGN-DELIVERY-CONTRACT.md` contain `?` where `→`/`—` belong (mojibake the encoding gate does not flag). | ACTIONED | Fixed in merged clean branch PR #346; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1531/current-sha-control.txt. |
| 13 | NIT | `_scope_key` and `_norm_scope` express overlapping scope normalization with different semantics; readers must diff two near-identical predicates. | ACTIONED | Fixed in merged clean branch PR #346; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1531/current-sha-control.txt. |
| 14 | NIT | `scripts/dev/backlog_db_export.py` uses `import os as _os` inside the write loop instead of the module-level import. | ACTIONED | Fixed in merged clean branch PR #346; evidence: engineering/evidence/BI-PF-1531/current-sha-control.txt. |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Core cutover mechanics (default `on`, scoped allowlist, composite-key migration, fail-closed tenant handling, export/backfill/parity) are directionally correct and several prior majors are closed.
  New ship-blocking risk: authority resolution normalizes alias scopes while the DB tenant/query does not, so legacy `factory`/`portfolio` items can be lost from the authoritative tenant with parity reporting green.
  Governance risk: an ACTIONED disposition cites a conftest file that does not exist, and startup/readiness requires 0023 while the declared prerequisites stop at 0021/0022.
  Not approvable as-is; fix the tenant-key derivation (and parity scoping) plus the 0022 index-validity and prerequisite/0023 mismatch before merge.
